description: Harvest v5: Remotion and HyperFrames skills and prompts for motion designers, found 2026-10-28 (GitHub search by keyword, then every candidate shallow-cloned and counted). Ids start at L01 so they never clash with v1 (G*, W*), v2 (N*), v3 (V*) or v4 (K*). Run with `node server/harvest/cli.js --v5`. Output: harvest/data/L*/records.jsonl, then library/v5/skills.

nodes.name: Remotion skills (official + community + iart-ai motion packs)
nodes.notes: Cloned and counted SKILL.md: remotion-dev/skills 12, haidrrrry 1, wshuyi 1, Vincentwei1021 x3 (1 each), digitalsamba toolkit 14 (mixed video toolkit, 2 remotion skills), iart-ai packs: ad 3, data-animation 3, ecommerce 3, explainer 5, kinetic 1, map 1, motion-design 9, text-message 1, tiktok 4, youtube 2. Licences: Remotion skills follow Remotion's company licence (credit and link, preview only); wshuyi and Vincentwei1021 repos (except video-shotcraft, Apache-2.0) have no clear licence: preview plus link.

nodes.name: HyperFrames skills and templates
nodes.notes: Cloned and counted SKILL.md: heygen-com/hyperframes 7 (hyperframes, hyperframes-cli, hyperframes-registry, remotion-to-hyperframes, figma, media-use, slideshow), nexu-io/html-video 14 HyperFrames templates, howseen-ai 1, Tejashmakwana/motionmaxxing 1, feicaiclub/video-spec-builder 1 (Chinese).

excluded.reason: Example compositions and storyboards, no SKILL.md; not prompts or skills.
